title: Kehti Thi Ye Zainab
body:
kehti thi ye zainab se mohamed ki dulari
mai kya karoon bibi
qismat may judai ki ghadi aa gayi apni
mai kya karoon bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer pe kuch bas nahi chalta hai kisi ka
ek roz hai marna
kya maa ki judaai ka alam jhel sakogi
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jayega shabbir mera karbobala ko
maidan e wagha ko
jayegi meri jaan sawari bhi tumhari
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mere abbas ke saahil se hatenge
pyase hi rahenge
atfal ki durron se wahan pyas bujhegi
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum aun o mohamed ko raza marne ki dogi
khamosh rahogi
jab saamne aayegi mohamed ki jawani
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mil jayegi matti may payambar ki nishani
par ay mere jaani
seene may hi ghut jayega dum ro na sakogi
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar jayega pyasa lab e darya mera saqqa
qasim na rahega
tum bhai hassan ko bhi bahot yaad karogi
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peet'ti reh jaogi tum qaime ke dar par
aur shimr ka khanjar
chal jayega mit jayegi hyder ki nishani
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
